instruction: A candid action photograph captures a full shot from an eye-level angle inside a covered outdoor pavilion with a concrete floor. On the left, the man in the blue tank top (R2) lunges forward in a dynamic boxing stance, throwing a straight punch with his black boxing gloves. On the right, the man in the beige t-shirt (R1) stands defensively, leaning back to block the incoming blow with his own gloves. The open-air training facility is visible in the background. Bright, natural daylight fills the space, highlighting their athletic movements and casting soft shadows.

R1 leans back defensively and blocks R2's incoming punch
